description: Remaps an Input image using a custom UV map.

inputs.description: The image or atlas of images to be remapped.
inputs.label: Input#
inputs.name: in#

inputs.description: The custom UV map to be used for remapping.

name: Custom UV

parameters.description:
The input type of the node:
- 1: single image
- 4: atlas of 4 images
- 16: atlas of 16 images
Atlases can be created using the Tile2x2 node.
parameters.label: 2:Inputs
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: The scale of the input image along the X axis.
parameters.label: Scale X
parameters.name: sx

parameters.description: The scale of the input image along the Y axis.
parameters.label: Scale Y
parameters.name: sy

parameters.description: The random rotation applied to each remapped instance.
parameters.label: Rnd Rotate
parameters.name: rotate

parameters.description: The random scale applied to each remapped instance.
parameters.label: Rnd Scale
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description:
Clamp: Stretches the edges
Repeat: Tiles the input UV
Extend: Shows parts of the UV beyond the edges
parameters.label: UV Mode
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: Check to use variations of the input image
parameters.label: Variations
parameters.name: variations
